name: Measure
why: A repo's numbers, from collected to scored, published, goaled and fixed
ideal: Metrics are read live in CI, scored against sourced goals, published on every push, and each miss becomes a labeled issue a pull request closes.

sources.title: Google SRE book: service level objectives
GitHub: link a pull request to an issue

steps.name: Collect
steps.rule: Metrics are read live in CI for cents a pull request; a failed read is not measured, never 0.

steps.name: Score
steps.rule: A metric meets, nears or misses a goal that names its source, and every figure carries a recent read date.

steps.name: Page
steps.rule: The pages publish on every push to the default branch, so they are minutes old.

steps.name: Goal
steps.rule: Each miss becomes a typed issue with an area label if one pull request fixes it, else a board card.

steps.name: Fix
tools: A pull request that closes the issue
steps.rule: A merged pull request closes each miss's issue, so every fix is traced.
